name: Xcode Command Line Tools
description: Compilers, git, make and the other developer tools macOS needs to build software, without the full Xcode
note: Installed through Apple's own software update. Asks for your admin password.

name: Xcode
description: Apple's IDE and SDKs for building apps for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Vision Pro
note: Apple only ships Xcode through the Mac App Store. The command opens its page there (or uses mas if you have it); you click Get. It's a large download.

name: Shinybox
description: A personal library for Mac, iPad and iPhone: save links, notes, screenshots and files, then find them again with tags, smart lists and search inside your content
note: Only on the Mac App Store. The command opens its page there (or uses mas if you have it); you click Get. Free.

name: Pi
description: A coding agent that runs in your terminal and works on the files on your machine. Bring a subscription, an API key or a local model
note: A command-line tool, installed with npm: it needs Node.js (pick Node.js LTS from Languages & Runtimes too). Update later with `pi update`.
